VBO:0201096.summary: The Pugalier is a Pug–Cavalier King Charles Spaniel cross that includes several kinds of breeding. Cottage Canines records first crosses, later Pugalier matings and backcrosses toward either parent breed. Those differing lines can produce quite different dogs, including both short and longer coats; the name alone does not promise a particular temperament.
VBO:0201096.shortDescription: A Pug–Cavalier cross spanning first crosses, later generations and backcrosses, with substantial variation between lines.
